爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD021 水城理沙Mizuki Risa-闪光灯前
从来没在这么多人面前穿这么少。手指无意识地揪着衣角。
胸口起伏得厉害，连呼吸都变成了细细的颤抖。
摄影师喊“看镜头”。我抬起眼，强光灯下感觉自己像被彻底看穿。
耳根烧得通红，那份羞意混着莫名的兴奋，在血液里乱窜。
身型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD021 Mizuki Risa-In front of the flash
I've never worn so little in front of so many people before. My fingers unconsciously clutched the hem of my clothes.
My chest heaved violently, even my breathing became a soft tremor.
The photographer yelled, "Look at the camera!" I looked up, feeling completely exposed under the bright lights.
My ears burned bright red, a mixture of shyness and inexplicable excitement coursing through my veins.
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone
